findings.title: Missing security header: content-security-policy
findings.detail: The response did not include a 'content-security-policy' header.
findings.recommendation: Add a Content-Security-Policy header to restrict which scripts, styles, and resources the browser may load, mitigating XSS and data-injection attacks.

findings.title: Missing security header: x-content-type-options
findings.detail: The response did not include a 'x-content-type-options' header.
findings.recommendation: Add 'X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff' to stop browsers from MIME-sniffing responses away from the declared Content-Type.

findings.title: Missing security header: x-frame-options
findings.detail: The response did not include a 'x-frame-options' header.
findings.recommendation: Add 'X-Frame-Options: DENY' or 'SAMEORIGIN' (or a frame-ancestors CSP directive) to prevent clickjacking via iframes.

findings.title: Missing security header: referrer-policy
findings.detail: The response did not include a 'referrer-policy' header.
findings.recommendation: Add a 'Referrer-Policy' header (e.g. 'strict-origin-when-cross-origin') to avoid leaking full URLs to third-party sites via the Referer header.

findings.title: Missing security header: permissions-policy
findings.detail: The response did not include a 'permissions-policy' header.
findings.recommendation: Add a 'Permissions-Policy' header to explicitly disable browser features (camera, microphone, geolocation, etc.) your site doesn't use.

findings.title: 'server' header discloses server technology
findings.recommendation: Suppress or genericize the 'server' header at the server/proxy level so specific software versions aren't advertised to attackers scoping for known exploits.
